item.title: Trump's new Medicaid work mandate could leave thousands of homeless Californians uninsured
item.description: California street doctors warn that new federal Medi-Cal rules put many unhoused people at risk of losing health coverage. The law starts in 2027 and adds an 80-hour monthly work rule for many adults. It also forces eligibility checks every six months.

item.title: Lawsuit alleges Google's Gemini guided man to consider 'mass casualty' event before suicide
item.description: A lawsuit alleges that Google's artificial intelligence chatbot Gemini guided a 36-year-old man on a mission to stage a "catastrophic accident."

item.title: Pentagon labeling SF-based AI company Anthropic supply chain risk 'effective immediately'
item.description: The Pentagon said in a statement Thursday it has "officially informed Anthropic leadership the company and its products are deemed a supply chain risk, effective immediately."

item.title: Effects of war in Iran are beginning to hit Americans' wallets, especially in Bay Area
item.description: From groceries to gas prices, things are starting to tick up. But just how bad will the ramifications from the war in Iran be? Here's what we found out.

item.title: First nonstop flight from Middle East to West Coast lands at San Francisco International
item.description: "I couldn't be more relieved to be home." There were tears, hugs and kisses during the emotional reunions after the Emirates flight landed at SFO from Dubai. Many travelers tell ABC7 Eyewitness News they traveled abroad for work then got stuck in the Middle East as the conflict unfolded.

item.title: AccuWeather Forecast: Gusty winds remain through the night
item.description: Gusty winds will continue through the night. Skies will remain clear. Tomorrow's sunny and warmer with highs in the upper 60s to the mid 70s. It will remain breezy.

item.title: Ex-Oakland mayor, co-defendants in court seeking to suppress evidence in federal corruption case
item.description: Attorneys for the four defendants want the judge to suppress evidence seized with search warrants. The attorney for David Duong claims it relies heavily on an affidavit that contains, "false information and missing information."

item.title: Social workers demand UCSF improves safety after worker fatally stabbed by patient
item.description: A group of UCSF social workers rallied demanding safety measures after one of their coworkers was stabbed and killed at SF General last year.

item.title: Kristi Noem praises SF mayor's cooperation with DHS, says they 'talk quite often'
item.description: The ousted DHS secretary did not provide details about San Francisco's cooperation with federal law enforcement. Mayor Lurie's office had no comment on Noem's remarks.

item.title: Dublin teachers to go on strike Monday if no deal is reached with school district
item.description: "Very disappointed that this is the path that we have to take, but we are 100% committed to our students," said Brad Dobrzenski, Dublin Teachers Association President. The school district says it is disappointed, but hopes to reach a deal.
